# Alibaba PuHuiTi 2.0 — source and license not established for redistribution

Original repository file: `src/assets/fonts/AlibabaPuHuiTi.woff2`.

The embedded metadata identifies Alibaba PuHuiTi 2.0 55 Regular, version 2.00, with Alibaba (China) Co., Ltd. 2020–2021 copyright and Alibaba Design / Hanyi Fonts attribution. The font has no embedded license text or license-URL record. The exact strings and binary checksum are recorded in `embedded-name-metadata.json`.

The official [Alibaba Fonts website](https://www.alibabafonts.com/) currently serves its font catalog through `https://g.alicdn.com/uedmid/fonts-alibabagroup/0.10.4/js/index.js`. Its legal-statement link points to [a Yuque document titled “《阿里巴巴普惠体3.0版》法律声明”](https://www.yuque.com/yiguang-wkqc2/hgpff0/nus9wiinq4aeiegy). A statement for version 3.0 is not treated here as evidence of the terms under which the existing version 2.0 WOFF2 conversion was made or can be redistributed.

The former official version-2 address, `https://done.alibabadesign.com/puhuiti2.0`, did not complete a TLS connection during this check on 2026-10-16. No further provenance claim is made. The share package therefore omits this font binary and its menu/CSS registration, while retaining the original local installation unchanged. A recipient who wants this font should obtain it through the publisher and review the terms that accompany that download.

This document is a source-status note, not a font license or permission grant. No third-party repost is used as substitute authorization.
